The '''heavy blaster arm''' was a commercial [[Blaster/Legends|heavy blaster]]-equipped mechanical [[Limb/Legends|limb]] for [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]. Commonly sold in pairs, the arms were cylindrically shaped and possessed a dark gray [[Color/Legends|color]]. The product was traded during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CWA" /> a major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The heavy blaster arm was part of the [[:w:c:cwa:Protocol Droid Part Pack II|Protocol Droid Part Pack II]] for players in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], released in [[2010]]<ref name="Season 3 Premiere Announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref> and shut down on [[March 31]], [[2014]].<ref name="CWAClosure">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=2014-01-24|archivedate=20140127193845}}</ref> The heavy blaster arm, along with the [[Tusken language pack]], could be bought for 300 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]].<ref name="CWA" />
